drafter.private_reasoning: The draft is materially underdeveloped. Add balanced, customary mutual protections and clarify that the confidentiality period runs from each disclosure, without introducing or revealing client-specific confidential information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is a streamlined mutual NDA draft with customary confidentiality protections, exclusions, and return-or-destruction language. We have retained the proposed 24-month agreement term and three-year confidentiality period to keep the process moving. Please let us know if you have any focused comments.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE; CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. The parties wish to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”) and may disclose Confidential Information to one another. “Confidential Information” means non-public information disclosed by or on behalf of a party (the “Disclosing Party”) to the other party (the “Receiving Party”), in any form, that is identified as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature or the circumstances of disclosure. The existence and status of discussions concerning the Purpose are Confidential Information. Confidential Information does not include information the Receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure; (c) is received lawfully from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of or reference to Confidential Information.
edits.name: 1. PURPOSE; CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION

edits.text: 2. PROTECTION AND USE. The Receiving Party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose, protect it using at least the same degree of care it uses for its own similar information and no less than reasonable care, and not disclose it except to its and its affiliates’ directors, officers, employees, financing sources, and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties at least as protective as this Agreement. The Receiving Party is responsible for their compliance. The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by law or legal process, provided it gives prompt notice to the Disclosing Party where legally permitted and reasonably cooperates, at the Disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information, except that it may retain copies required by law or retained in routine backup systems, which remain subject to this Agreement.
edits.name: 2. PROTECTION AND USE

edits.text: 3. TERM; DURATION OF OBLIGATIONS. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing, unless the parties agree in writing to extend it. The obligations concerning each item of Confidential Information continue for three years from its disclosure; provided that information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law remains protected for so long as it retains that status.
edits.name: 3. TERM; DURATION OF OBLIGATIONS

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES; NO COMMITMENT. A breach may cause harm for which monetary damages may be inadequate, and the Disclosing Party may seek appropriate injunctive or other equitable relief, in addition to any remedies available at law, subject to applicable law. Neither party is obligated to proceed with any transaction, and either may end discussions at any time. No license or other rights are granted in Confidential Information except the limited right to use it for the Purpose.
edits.name: 4. REMEDIES; NO COMMITMENT
